reviews.intro: Choosing an engine workshop is a significant decision. Customer feedback can help you understand the assessment, communication and repair experience behind the service.

items.quote: The inspection was explained in plain English, and I understood the proposed work before deciding how to proceed.
The written scope made it clear what the engine work covered and which additional items needed a separate decision.
I appreciated being able to discuss the symptoms, the engine details and the next assessment step directly with the workshop.

heading.text: Meet Boby and See the Engine

paragraphs: Boby is the mechanic behind Boby Engine Work. The business brings more than ten years' experience and over 1,000 clients across its work on German, British and other selected vehicles.

The useful difference is a repair tied to the actual engine. Identification, inspection and a clear scope explain why a rebuild is needed, which components can be retained and what sits outside the engine-core work. An existing report is useful evidence, but it still needs to agree with the condition of the fitted engine.
Talk to Boby about the symptoms, earlier repairs and how you use the vehicle. That conversation helps distinguish a practical repair from assumptions based only on a badge or fault code.
